name: Landing Craft, Vehicle, Personnel (LCVP)
blurb: A Hangar-only Higgins-type landing craft: raked bow ramp (hinged at its foot), cargo and personnel well, stern coxswain station with armor, engine box and two .30 cal gun tubs.
history: The LCVP carried troops and vehicles directly onto beaches through its bow ramp. U.S. Navy material fixes its overall length and beam; the hull lines, 2.10 m height, ramp width, armor, tubs, mounts and fittings of this original model are estimates (no plan was read).

sources.title: Ship-to-Shore Movement, Naval History and Heritage Command
